A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

we have developed a system that provides real-time access, privacy, and security to a wide range of sensors, and we have shown that we can do this while maintaining the energy requirements of a sensor node at a level that allows it to operate continuously for months.

we have designed a system that provides real-time access and analysis to data from heterogeneous wireless sensor networks, that can be deployed at large scale in a variety of environments, that provides context-aware power management, that provides dynamic privacy policies, and that can be easily adapted to different applications.
